description: Moves an agent's switch, as the owner would on Agents: paused, ask (show me each) or own (on its own). Only where the switch changes something for that agent (input.app.agents says what each one's switch does): for one whose switch only pauses, paused pauses it and own switches it back on, and ask is refused; one with no switch is refused with where its own controls are. It never starts an agent that has not been started. Returns the change and the agent as it now stands. It needs an act key.

mode.description: own: it learns from the owner's first few answers, then works on its own (where the owner said the business's work runs on its own, no learning: what the owner's answers cover goes from the start, and the rest asks); ask: it shows the owner each piece first, and what it had lined up comes back as a card; paused: it stops, and what it already had waiting is held until switched back

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
